text:
elaine: Quick check — I pushed the zeta30b weights to s3://redwood-artifacts/weights/zeta30b/v1/ but noticed tokenizer.json has 'pad_token': null. Anyone seen tokenizer pad offsets mismatch during serving?

raj: Thanks. Can you paste the exact S3 path? Also did you mirror from HF or straight upload?

elaine: path: s3://redwood-artifacts/weights/zeta30b/v1/model.safetensors and s3://redwood-artifacts/weights/zeta30b/v1/tokenizer.json. Mirror was via our hf-sync job with presign. hf source: hf://org/zeta30b.

sam: Heads-up — hf-sync created a gzipped tokenizer at times. If tokenizer.json is gzipped the runtime fails to parse, we strip gzip automatically in registry but not in Dedicated handoffs. Might be that.

amy: Quick checksum? run `sha256sum model.safetensors` locally or `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts --key weights/zeta30b/v1/model.safetensors --query ETag` but ETag != sha256 for multipart. For registry we store sha256 in manifest.json ; check there.

elaine: checked manifest.json at s3://redwood-artifacts/weights/zeta30b/v1/manifest.json — it has "sha256": "abc123..." but head-object ETag is different. CI had a note about presigned upload using multipart giving different ETag.

ingest-bot: Presign job: upload completed, checkpoint 2026-03-12T15:02Z, size 34GB, manifest validated (schema v2).

sam: If gzip tokenizer, decompress: ```
zcat tokenizer.json.gz > tokenizer.json
``` then reupload. Also update manifest sha256s. I can patch the registry record if you want.

elaine: I can reupload tokenizer uncompressed and bump manifest. Also, what about tokenizer pad_token null — should we set pad_token to ""? Our tokenizer loader expects an int id or special token string.

raj: set pad_token to "<|pad|>" and add to vocab if missing. But if vocab change, need to update model metadata; prefer mapping pad to existing eos id if possible. Check tokenizer.vocab for pad entry.

amy: For config validation, run `tools/registry/validate_manifest.py --path s3://...` — that'll flag pad_token missing and checksum mismatch. I ran it on a local copy earlier.

elaine: thanks all. I'll reupload tokenizer uncompressed and run validate, ping when done. @sam can you standby for manifest patch? :thumbsup:

sam: on it, +1

raj: also add a small note in the onboarding doc about presign multipart ETag caveat. :memo:

ingest-bot: manual note: issue #4129 created (artifact-ingest: presign-etag-ambig).
